problems.title: Layout outputs alias one mutable candidate
claim: The method obtains separate layout-specific mutations and aggregates them by consensus voting.
analysis: MLLM_mutate changes its candidate list in place. Each layout receives the same list, and saved outputs keep that same reference. Successive replacements \(2,3,4\) can leave every voting input equal to \([4,1]\), so the three supposedly independent proposals become the last mutated state. Earlier layouts also receive changed inputs.
result: The layout proposals alias the same mutable candidate, so consensus need not aggregate independent layout outputs.
assumptions: The exact source version and operative conditions stated in this analysis.
repair: Copy the original list independently for each layout and preserve independent result snapshots; no full-network benchmark repair is asserted.
problems.impact_rationale: This establishes the stated local correction or limitation. A consequential failure of the paper's central result has not been demonstrated.
problems.existing_correction_status: Proposed correction; independent verification and author adoption remain unestablished.

problems.title: Mutation can alter retained parents and elites
problems.source_location: Single-layout mutation caller, elite storage and EVC generation update.
claim: Elite preservation assumes the stored candidate and fitness refer to the same solution.
analysis: The single-layout branch mutates a list shared with its parent/elite record. Its node set can therefore change without refreshing the associated fitness. This breaks the state/fitness invariant independently of multi-layout voting.
result: The elite’s stored fitness can become inconsistent with its mutated solution.
assumptions: The exact source version and operative conditions stated in this analysis.
repair: Copy before mutation and recompute fitness for the exact stored candidate; benchmark effect remains unmeasured.
problems.impact_rationale: This establishes the stated local correction or limitation. A consequential failure of the paper's central result has not been demonstrated.
problems.existing_correction_status: Proposed correction; independent verification and author adoption remain unestablished.

problems.title: Injected improvements do not refresh processor best state
problems.source_location: Distributed.py/EVC.py injection and best-state update paths.
claim: Cross-domain injection is intended to retain a better evaluated solution.
analysis: After accepting a superior injected candidate, the processor leaves its cached best solution/fitness unchanged. A later generation or summary can lose the better evaluated solution by consulting stale best state. This is distinct from whether the injected solution is actually feasible.
result: The cross-domain injection route can discard a superior evaluated candidate by keeping stale best state. Historical score effects remain unmeasured.
assumptions: The exact source version and operative conditions stated in this analysis.
repair: Update the accepted population state and cached best candidate/fitness together. Corrected local bookkeeping does not establish a full MLLM benchmark result.
problems.impact_rationale: This establishes the stated local correction or limitation. A consequential failure of the paper's central result has not been demonstrated.
problems.existing_correction_status: Proposed correction; independent verification and author adoption remain unestablished.
